title: Dual-credit mathematics as a readiness lever: Indiana school-level analysis and access atlas
description:
Links Indiana Commission for Higher Education first-year college outcomes to Civil Rights Data Collection course offerings for Indiana public high schools (359 schools, 1,379 school-cohorts, 99,332 Indiana public college enrollees, classes of 2021–2024) to estimate the school-level association between dual-credit uptake and college readiness, and maps where calculus and dual enrollment are missing. 77 of 381 traditional public high schools (20%) offered no calculus, from 5% in the lowest-poverty quartile to 41% in the highest.

Includes the reproducible pipeline, derived school panel and access files, preprint, manuscript and interactive access atlas. Code MIT; derived data, figures and text CC BY 4.0.
